school_name: Citadel Military College of South Carolina
title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover the best environments for focused academic work at The Citadel, from high-tech business labs to historic reading rooms and dedicated student success centers.

cards.title: Collaborative Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Daniel Library
cards.notes: Reserve one of the four collaborative study rooms for group projects. These spaces are equipped with technology to support team-based academic work.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms in the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Daniel Library features four collaborative study rooms and a Zoom interview/online exam space available for student booking.
cards.access_notes: Open during library operating hours; reservations are recommended via the LibCal system.

cards.title: Historic Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Daniel Library
cards.notes: Study surrounded by Citadel history in this quiet room housing yearbooks and historic publications. It offers a traditional academic atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, historic reading room located within Daniel Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Prioleau Reading Room houses Citadel yearbooks and other historic publications for student use.
cards.access_notes: Located inside Daniel Library; accessible during standard library hours.

cards.title: Bastin Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Baker School of Business
cards.notes: Utilize the open atrium for casual study between classes. This modern space is a central hub for business students and features ample natural light.
cards.short_summary: A large, modern common area for studying in the business school.
cards.evidence_claim: Bastin Hall features large common areas and an atrium typically used by students for studying.
cards.access_notes: Open to students during academic building hours.

cards.title: Financial Trading Lab
cards.subtitle: Bastin Hall
cards.notes: Access Bloomberg terminals and real-time market data in this state-of-the-art lab. Ideal for finance students needing specialized software.
cards.short_summary: A high-tech lab simulating a real trading floor with 29 computer terminals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bastin Financial Lab features 29 computer terminals, a 22-foot ticker display, and access to financial data tools.
cards.access_notes: Primarily for business students; check for lab availability between classes.

cards.title: Kerr Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Bond Hall 261
cards.notes: Find a quiet spot or meet for group work in this dedicated business student space. It includes private study rooms with monitors for project review.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study and meeting space for business students in Bond Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kerr Reading Room in Bond Hall 261 provides quiet study space and three private study rooms with monitors.
cards.access_notes: Open every school day for business students.

cards.title: Mathematics Lab
cards.subtitle: Thompson Hall
cards.notes: Get help with difficult problem sets or study in a focused environment. The lab provides specialized support for math and data analytics.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated lab for mathematics study and tutoring support.
cards.evidence_claim: Thompson Hall houses the Mathematics Lab, providing academic support and study space for students.
cards.access_notes: Check the Student Success Center website for current lab hours.

cards.entity_name: Angela W. Williams Student Success Center
cards.title: Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: Thompson Hall 117
cards.notes: Visit for academic coaching or subject-area tutoring. It is a welcoming environment designed to help students excel academically.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive academic support hub with various study resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Success Center (SSC) in Thompson Hall 117 offers academic coaching, tutoring, and a writing lab.
cards.access_notes: Appointments are recommended; walk-ins are welcome during operating hours.

cards.title: Legal Studies Classroom
cards.subtitle: School of Humanities
cards.notes: Study in a unique mock courtroom environment. This new facility is ideal for pre-law students and those in the School of Humanities.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art mock courtroom used for classes and study.
cards.evidence_claim: The new Capers Hall includes a Legal Studies classroom designed as a mock courtroom for student use.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours when classes are not in session.

cards.title: Starbucks Study Lounge
cards.subtitle: Mark Clark Hall
cards.notes: Enjoy a coffee while you work in this social study spot. It's a popular choice for students who prefer a bit of background noise.
cards.short_summary: A full-service Starbucks with seating areas inside the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: Mark Clark Hall houses a full-service Starbucks Coffee and common areas for students.
cards.access_notes: Open during retail dining hours; seating is available for studying.

cards.title: Bond Café Seating
cards.subtitle: Bond Hall
cards.notes: Grab a hot meal and find a table for a quiet study session. This café offers a more relaxed alternative to the main mess hall.
cards.short_summary: A quiet dining and study area located in historic Bond Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Bond Hall is home to Bond Café, which offers a quiet, hot meal and seating for students.
